title: 전문심리위원규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:6:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2-6 (Delegation of Duties)
(1) The Minister of the National Court Administration may delegate to the president of each high court duties concerning the commissioning, etc. of full-time expert commissioners and appraisal management commissioners under Articles 2-2 and 2-4.
(2) Where the Minister of the National Court Administration delegates duties concerning the commissioning, etc. of full-time expert commissioners and appraisal management commissioners pursuant to paragraph (1), the Minister may decide not to establish a Selection Committee.
